scope: Member A P05: E2 no-augmentation versus E4 moderate-augmentation CSV evidence and original artifact inventory
precision_caveat: Metrics use the exact decimal values in the exported CSVs, with Decimal arithmetic (50 significant digits) before JSON float serialization. Predictions, residuals and absolute errors were independently exported to one decimal place. Original full-precision predictions are not recovered.
rounding_assumptions: Assume the same exact labels and each original prediction differs from its CSV value by at most 0.05. With MAE computed from the rounded predictions, abs(MSE_csv - MSE_original) <= 0.1 * MAE_csv + 0.0025. MAE differs by at most 0.05 and R2 by at most the MSE bound / label variance. Historical MSEs displayed to one decimal add a further 0.05 reporting bound. The original pipeline also casts targets/operations to float32. Original-log compatibility uses a separately stated 0.0001 price-unit numerical allowance in addition to the ideal CSV rounding bound; it is a comparison tolerance, not a verified maximum error for every original floating-point operation. Compatibility does not recover or verify the original run.
historical_values_source: docs/experiments.md at 4ba5d22751a529ac7f4ec56947ea86d7cb531159; historical values, not new training results
